title: 🌴 Wellness Retreats in India
h1: Rejuvenate Your Body, Mind & Spirit with Ayurveda
intro: India is globally known for its authentic Ayurveda wellness retreats, where patients and travelers experience a complete reset of body and mind. These retreats combine detox therapies, yoga, meditation, herbal healing, and personalized diets in serene natural locations. Whether you seek recovery after medical treatment, stress relief, or a preventive health boost — Ayurveda retreats in India provide holistic healing at an affordable cost.

sections.heading: Benefits of Ayurveda Wellness Retreats
points: Full-body detoxification & rejuvenation
Stress relief & mental relaxation
Weight management & improved metabolism
Enhanced immunity & disease prevention
Natural anti-aging & skin glow
Improved sleep, focus & emotional balance

sections.heading: Popular Programs in Ayurveda Retreats
points: Panchakarma Detox: Removes toxins, resets body balance
Stress & Anxiety Relief: Shirodhara, meditation & yoga
Weight Loss & Metabolism Boost: Herbal therapies & diet plans
Skin & Anti-Aging Rejuvenation: Natural beauty treatments
Post-Surgery Recovery Retreats: Gentle therapies to regain strength
Yoga & Meditation Retreats: Mind-body balance in peaceful settings

sections.heading: Top Wellness Retreat Destinations in India
points: Kerala Backwaters: Authentic Ayurveda with beachside retreats
Rishikesh & Himalayas: Spiritual healing with yoga & Ayurveda
Goa: Relaxation retreats combining Ayurveda & beach life
Mysuru: Traditional yoga & holistic care
Delhi-NCR & Gurugram: Urban retreats with modern facilities

sections.heading: Cost of Ayurveda Wellness Retreats in India
points: 1-Week Retreat: $350 – $600
2-Week Wellness Program: $700 – $1,200
3-Week Luxury Wellness Retreat: $1,200 – $2,500
Includes accommodation, therapies, yoga, consultations & meals.

sections.heading: Why Choose India for Ayurveda Retreats?
points: Authentic Ayurveda practiced by certified doctors
Affordable packages compared to global wellness resorts
Serene natural locations – beaches, backwaters, mountains
Combination of Ayurveda, yoga & meditation
Customized programs for medical recovery & wellness
